snippet.title: GIGASWORD Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Balance the weight of the GIGASWORD, battling between brain and brawn. Solve intricate puzzles, discover covert chambers, and slash through foes as Ezra fights to reach the top of the Nestrium and recover the God Crystal within. Can he restore the world's coherency before it's too late?

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1885930/GIGASWORD/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.

Love indie games? Subscribe and hit the bell!

Six One Indie is a grassroots collective focused on making gaming showcases, awards, and overall visibility more approachable for independent developers.
